import os, sys, copy, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-frvct4dk/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_5pxd1jtl")
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = copy.deepcopy(model)
    inputs = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]; targets = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    calls = []
    for i,l in enumerate(model.model.layers): l.register_forward_hook(lambda m,a,o,i=i: calls.append(i))
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    tot = 0
    for x,y in zip(inputs,targets):
        lg = ref(x).logits; l = F.cross_entropy(lg.view(-1,100), y.view(-1))/3; l.backward(); tot += l.item()
    maxd = 0; n = 0
    for (name,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None: n += 1; maxd = max(maxd, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(f"ws={ws} rank={rank} layers={sorted(set(calls))} loss={loss} ref={tot:.6f} params_with_grad={n} maxdiff={maxd:.2e}")
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws, port in [(1, 29511), (2, 29512)]: mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, port), nprocs=ws)
EOF
